## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `2a241332d3375c7bb4489cd024e7697abea9b737`
Local-runs: probe — one read-only `git merge-tree --write-tree` in the seat's checkout, of this head against the sibling governed PR #21999's head `8cdefa6c` and against `origin/main`, to read whether the two in-flight edits of `filing-gate.md` and `triage-duties.md` stack without conflict; nothing built, run or re-run

Face reviewed: governed rule text (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/**` and `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` — protocol semantics; Tier S, every path under `.claude/**`). Inputs: card #21992 (body and the triage grade 6017868609), PR #22000's body and file list, the net diff of `2a241332` against its merge-base `6befe19c` (+5 / −5 across 3 files), and the two report comments (6018992259 authoritative, superseding 6018856701). Check-runs on the head at 2026-10-06T15:03Z: 25 completed (success or expected skip), 1 in progress (`Lint & Repo Gates`) — the landing waits on it.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept set / public surface: none changed. No package, no `skills/**`, no schema, no error code; the `os-dev.md` frontmatter (`model:`) is untouched. Right.
- Property (1), UX defects are class (a) on equal footing: filing-gate :13 (「① 含用户可见的体验缺陷,与功能缺陷同等…」), triage-duties :44 (「(a) 不分功能与体验…」), os-dev :43 (sub-item of the (a)/(b) line). Matches the ruling 「同意,立卡起草这条规则」 and the three properties the card names as the ruling's. Right.
- Property (2), still owing a stable public-surface repro, a named fix site and a taste-free expected-vs-actual: carried inside each of the three lines (「稳定复现、落点具名、预期不凭审美」 / 「能用但用户可见地错」 / 「须复现且落点具名」); `reach:` for a UX defect stays the existing 「公开入口 … 界面」 arm, no new reach type. Right.
- Property (3), the fence: filing-gate :14 (「⛔ 不是卡:纯审美偏好、重设计与新功能提议(走 ②)、无用户可见代价的性能观察。」). Right.
- The 判例 line (filing-gate :15, the dashboard case ⇒ 立 / 「配色换个好看的」⇒ 不立) closes the ① group after the fence instead of hanging under the (b) 判例 line that PR #21999 deletes. Probe: `git merge-tree --write-tree 8cdefa6c 2a241332` exit 0, tree `032fb524`; against `origin/main` `f0022c46` exit 0, tree `4ed610e0`; in the stacked tree `filing-gate.md` is 58 lines and `triage-duties.md` 120 — both at their ceilings, so the two PRs land in either order without a ratchet breach. Right.
- The card drafted four filing-gate lines; three landed. The stand-alone forms line (six named forms) is not added; four of its forms travel in the triage-duties and os-dev parentheticals (截断、遮挡、白占首屏、误导文案) and the 判例 line carries the concrete case; 「删除不点名对象」 and 「显示原始值」 are not spelled anywhere in the landed text. The ruling's three properties are intact and the card says the wording is the lane's to tighten; the forms list was illustrative. Accepted — recorded so the next card on this face knows the two forms are unnamed.
- Deletions (5), each surviving home verified on `origin/main`: filing-gate :30 (429 ⇒ stop writing, record on the seat post) → SKILL.md :93 「429 即停写」 + triage-duties :117 (限流/重试类运维细节只进座位贴); filing-gate :31 (closures never by a script loop; pacing) → filing-gate :28 (十张一组, kept) + SKILL.md :93 (≥3 秒/笔) + AGENTS.md :420 (`write-pace.mjs` serialises and spaces every write verb); filing-gate :32 (first write of a fire reads back `user.type`) → platform-readings :133 (every write's `user.login` / `user.type` read back) and :135, the consequence line :33 kept; triage-duties :84 (label-write four steps; ⛔ MCP `issue_write`) → SKILL.md :92 and the 标签写恒四步 invariant, rest-channel :44, execution-duties, os-dev :304, AGENTS.md :420–:421; os-dev :203 (⛔ `git stash`) → AGENTS.md :323–:329 and the SKILL.md 红线 line, with os-dev :201 still naming the stash stack as shared and `guard-shared-stash.sh` enforcing it. No rule lost. Right.
- Widths of the 5 added lines: 119 · 112 · 115 · 115 · 114 bytes (`LC_ALL=C awk`), none over the 120 cap; no issue number in any added line; `check:agent-model-declared` unaffected (frontmatter untouched). Right.

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: no` on the claim (6018313288) and at PR body line 2 — right: no published contract moves. `skip-changeset` on the PR — right: `.claude/**` is the fast lane and no package publishes. No existing changeset is edited.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The coordinator correction (second commit `2a241332`, the 判例 line moved off the (b) 判例 anchor): accepted; the probe above is its evidence.
- 3 filing-gate lines instead of 4, and the card's ceiling-raise fallback not exercised: accepted — a raise would edit `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, outside the fence, and 新增门禁/棘轮默认否; the dev named the one-line raise (58 → 59) in the body in case the seat wants the forms line — the seat does not: the three properties stand without it.
- Mechanism probes (folding the fence into filing-gate :20 or the triage line into :43 measures 130 bytes each — over the cap): accepted, separate lines are right.
- `origin/main` advanced to `f0022c46` during the pr_create stroke; no merge performed; merge-tree against it is clean (above): accepted.
- Fifth GitHub write (the superseding report comment, because the first named the pre-correction head and placement): accepted — GitHub is the report's authoritative source and the first comment is explicitly superseded.
- The model-free commit trailer pair and the session-URL footer instead of the harness reminder: correct per the dev definition.
- PR body corrections the dev could not write (dev writes the body once): the seat writes them — `Head 8014e8ba` → `2a241332`; the 判例 row's anchor cell; the sibling-overlap sentence.
- Acceptance note (`carrier:` the reviewer of PR #21999): #21999 deleted `filing-gate.md:15` outside the region its claim declared — read by this seat, which is that reviewer; noted in #21999's record as a verified deletion with a surviving home; no card.
- `open_questions`: none.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-21992-ux-defects-are-class-a`
Reviewed-by: `session_0181E4ZeZmWyknawnauxD2CE`

**VERDICT: PASS**
